C0955.title: Online Scalped Tickets Denied Entry at Sanxingdui Museum Due to Identity Mismatch
C0955.summary: On August 16, 2023, the Sanxingdui Museum responded to visitors being denied entry with online scalped tickets, stating that such tickets may involve identity mismatches—where the visitor's identity does not match the ID information registered during ticket purchase—or counterfeit tickets. The museum has strengthened ticket verification measures starting that day.
